nodes.text: 一點改變 給家人的更多 ｜A little change for home A lot more for family｜IKEA Hong Kong

一點改變 給家人的更多 我們都希望家人每天過得好、睡得好。 立即欣賞短片，細味家的小確幸，為家人作一點改變吧! 全新IKEA產品情報、創新低價產品推廣及家居布置靈感盡在2020 IKEA產品目錄: http://bit.ly/2MrXvai 啟發您為家人作一點改變，打造更舒適稱心的安樂窩！ A little change for home A lot more for family We all want our families to smile happily by day and sleep soundly at night. Watch the video now to savour those precious moments we all share with our loved ones, and start bringing some changes home! IKEA new products, Even Lower Price range and different home furnishing ideas are now showcased in 2020 IKEA Catalogue: http://bit.ly/2HeMchJ To inspire you bringing some changes home and to build a warmer, more comfortable home!
